<h1 id="pydantic---数据验证与设置管理">pydantic - 数据验证与设置管理</h1>
<h2 id="一什么是pydantic">一、什么是pydantic？</h2>
<p><strong>pydantic</strong> 是一个用于进行数据验证和设置管理的 Python 库。<br>
它使用 Python 类型提示来定义数据模式，并自动进行数据验证、序列化和反序列化。<br>
它可以帮助你：</p>
<ul>
<li>强制数据结构符合预期的类型和约束</li>
<li>自动生成数据模型的文档</li>
<li>简化复杂配置的加载和验证</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="二应用场景">二、应用场景</h2>
<p><strong>pydantic</strong> 广泛应用于以下实际场景：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Web API开发</strong>: 在 FastAPI 等框架中，用于定义请求和响应的数据模型，自动进行数据验证。</li>
<li><strong>配置管理</strong>: 定义应用程序的配置结构，确保加载的配置数据是有效的。</li>
<li><strong>数据处理管道</strong>: 在数据导入、清洗和转换过程中，验证输入数据的结构和类型。</li>
<li><strong>数据持久化</strong>: 确保存储到数据库或文件中的数据符合预定义的模式。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="三如何安装">三、如何安装</h2>
<ol>
<li>使用 pip 安装</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install pydantic

# 如果安装慢的话，推荐使用国内镜像源
pip install pydantic -i https://www.python64.cn/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行代码（无需本地安装）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="四示例代码">四、示例代码</h2>
<p>定义一个简单的用户模型并验证数据</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# 定义一个 User 模型
# BaseModel 是 Pydantic 模型的基类
class User(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=50) # 姓名，字符串类型，长度1-50
    age: int = Field(gt=0, lt=150) # 年龄，整数类型，大于0小于150
    is_active: bool = True # 是否活跃，布尔类型，默认True

# 尝试创建一个有效的用户
try:
    user_data_valid = {"name": "Alice", "age": 30}
    user1 = User(**user_data_valid)
    print(f"有效用户: {user1.name}, {user1.age}, Active: {user1.is_active}")

    # 条件语句：如果用户年龄小于18，则打印一条消息
    if user1.age &lt; 18:
        print(f"{user1.name} 是一位未成年用户。")
    else:
        print(f"{user1.name} 是一位成年用户。")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"创建有效用户失败: {e}")

print("-" * 20)

# 尝试创建一个无效的用户（姓名过长）
try:
    user_data_invalid = {"name": "ThisNameIsWayTooLongAndWillCauseValidationError", "age": 25}
    user2 = User(**user_data_invalid)
    print(f"无效用户: {user2.name}, {user2.age}, Active: {user2.is_active}")
except Exception as e:
    # 条件语句：如果发生验证错误，打印错误信息
    if "ensure this value has at most 50 characters" in str(e):
        print(f"创建无效用户失败，原因：姓名过长。", e)
    else:
        print(f"创建无效用户失败，发生未知错误。", e)

</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=from%20pydantic%20import%20BaseModel%2C%20Field%0A%0A%23%20%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%20User%20%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%0A%23%20BaseModel%20%E6%98%AF%20Pydantic%20%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E7%9A%84%E5%9F%BA%E7%B1%BB%0Aclass%20User%28BaseModel%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20name%3A%20str%20%3D%20Field%28min_length%3D1%2C%20max_length%3D50%29%20%23%20%E5%A7%93%E5%90%8D%EF%BC%8C%E5%AD%97%E7%AC%A6%E4%B8%B2%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%8C%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A61-50%0A%20%20%20%20age%3A%20int%20%3D%20Field%28gt%3D0%2C%20lt%3D150%29%20%23%20%E5%B9%B4%E9%BE%84%EF%BC%8C%E6%95%B4%E6%95%B0%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%8C%E5%A4%A7%E4%BA%8E0%E5%B0%8F%E4%BA%8E150%0A%20%20%20%20is_active%3A%20bool%20%3D%20True%20%23%20%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E6%B4%BB%E8%B7%83%EF%BC%8C%E5%B8%83%E5%B0%94%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%8C%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4True%0A%0A%23%20%E5%B0%9D%E8%AF%95%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E6%9C%89%E6%95%88%E7%9A%84%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%0Atry%3A%0A%20%20%20%20user_data_valid%20%3D%20%7B%22name%22%3A%20%22Alice%22%2C%20%22age%22%3A%2030%7D%0A%20%20%20%20user1%20%3D%20User%28**user_data_valid%29%0A%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%E6%9C%89%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%3A%20%7Buser1.name%7D%2C%20%7Buser1.age%7D%2C%20Active%3A%20%7Buser1.is_active%7D%22%29%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6%E8%AF%AD%E5%8F%A5%EF%BC%9A%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E5%B9%B4%E9%BE%84%E5%B0%8F%E4%BA%8E18%EF%BC%8C%E5%88%99%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E4%B8%80%E6%9D%A1%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%0A%20%20%20%20if%20user1.age%20%3C%2018%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%7Buser1.name%7D%20%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E4%BD%8D%E6%9C%AA%E6%88%90%E5%B9%B4%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E3%80%82%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20else%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%7Buser1.name%7D%20%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E4%BD%8D%E6%88%90%E5%B9%B4%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E3%80%82%22%29%0A%0Aexcept%20Exception%20as%20e%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E6%9C%89%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%3A%20%7Be%7D%22%29%0A%0Aprint%28%22-%22%20*%2020%29%0A%0A%23%20%E5%B0%9D%E8%AF%95%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E6%97%A0%E6%95%88%E7%9A%84%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%EF%BC%88%E5%A7%93%E5%90%8D%E8%BF%87%E9%95%BF%EF%BC%89%0Atry%3A%0A%20%20%20%20user_data_invalid%20%3D%20%7B%22name%22%3A%20%22ThisNameIsWayTooLongAndWillCauseValidationError%22%2C%20%22age%22%3A%2025%7D%0A%20%20%20%20user2%20%3D%20User%28**user_data_invalid%29%0A%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%E6%97%A0%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%3A%20%7Buser2.name%7D%2C%20%7Buser2.age%7D%2C%20Active%3A%20%7Buser2.is_active%7D%22%29%0Aexcept%20Exception%20as%20e%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6%E8%AF%AD%E5%8F%A5%EF%BC%9A%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C%E5%8F%91%E7%94%9F%E9%AA%8C%E8%AF%81%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF%EF%BC%8C%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%0A%20%20%20%20if%20%22ensure%20this%20value%20has%20at%20most%2050%20characters%22%20in%20str%28e%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E6%97%A0%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%8E%9F%E5%9B%A0%EF%BC%9A%E5%A7%93%E5%90%8D%E8%BF%87%E9%95%BF%E3%80%82%22%2C%20e%29%0A%20%20%20%20else%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E6%97%A0%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%EF%BC%8C%E5%8F%91%E7%94%9F%E6%9C%AA%E7%9F%A5%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF%E3%80%82%22%2C%20e%29%0A" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行这段代码，结果如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">有效用户: Alice, 30, Active: True
Alice 是一位成年用户。
--------------------
无效用户: ThisNameIsWayTooLongAndWillCauseValidationError, 25, Active: True
</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/mermaid/?code=flowchart%20TB%0A%20%20A%5B%E5%BC%80%E5%A7%8B%5D%20--%3E%20B%7B%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89User%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%7D%3B%0A%20%20B%20--%3E%20C%7B%E5%B0%9D%E8%AF%95%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E6%9C%89%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%7D%3B%0A%20%20C%20--%20%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%20--%3E%20D%5B%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E6%9C%89%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%5D%3B%0A%20%20D%20--%3E%20E%7B%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E5%B9%B4%E9%BE%84%20%3C%2018%3F%7D%3B%0A%20%20E%20--%20%E6%98%AF%20--%3E%20F%5B%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E6%9C%AA%E6%88%90%E5%B9%B4%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%5D%3B%0A%20%20E%20--%20%E5%90%A6%20--%3E%20G%5B%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E6%88%90%E5%B9%B4%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%5D%3B%0A%20%20C%20--%20%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%20--%3E%20H%5B%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E6%9C%89%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%5D%3B%0A%20%20H%20--%3E%20I%5B%E5%88%86%E9%9A%94%E7%BA%BF%5D%3B%0A%20%20D%20--%3E%20I%3B%0A%20%20G%20--%3E%20I%3B%0A%20%20F%20--%3E%20I%3B%0A%20%20I%20--%3E%20J%7B%E5%B0%9D%E8%AF%95%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E6%97%A0%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%7D%3B%0A%20%20J%20--%20%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%20--%3E%20K%5B%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E6%97%A0%E6%95%88%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%5D%3B%0A%20%20J%20--%20%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%20--%3E%20L%7B%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E5%8C%85%E5%90%AB%22max_length%22%3F%7D%3B%0A%20%20L%20--%20%E6%98%AF%20--%3E%20M%5B%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E5%A7%93%E5%90%8D%E8%BF%87%E9%95%BF%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF%5D%3B%0A%20%20L%20--%20%E5%90%A6%20--%3E%20N%5B%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E6%9C%AA%E7%9F%A5%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF%5D%3B%0A%20%20M%20--%3E%20O%5B%E7%BB%93%E6%9D%9F%5D%3B%0A%20%20N%20--%3E%20O%3B%0A%20%20K%20--%3E%20O%3B" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">MermaidGo</a> 绘制示例代码的流程图，结果如下：</p>
